prompt: "Write a behavior tree for the robot to execute the command using only available nodes. If robot sees object, approach it. If not, scan area. Take object, move, check properties and perform task. list of available nodes: <Action ID = TakeObject    /> <Action ID = MoveToDestination    /> <Action ID = ApproachObject    /> <Action ID = ScanArea    /> <Condition ID = IsAreaScanned    /> <Condition ID = IsDestinationReached    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectApproached    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectVisible    /> <Action ID = CheckObjectProperties    /> <Action ID = MoveToNextArea    /> <SubTree ID = SpecificTask    />"
code:
SEQUENCE
			IF IsObjectApproached? THEN
			DO TakeObject
	ELSE
		DO MoveToDestination
			IF IsDestinationReached? THEN
			DO CheckObjectProperties
	ELSE
		DO SpecificTask
	END
